reconcile.note: Matthew Henry explains that Solomon's royal line legally passed to Nathan's branch through Salathiel, uniting Matthew's and Luke's genealogies in Jesus.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Thomas Paine catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Thomas Paine, The Age of Reason, Part the Second (1795).

sides.snippet: David became the father of Solomon by her who had been the wife of Uriah
sides.verseText: Jesse became the father of David the king. David became the father of Solomon by her who had been the wife of Uriah.

sides.snippet: the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli
sides.verseText: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,
